summary: An input with things beside it — an icon, a unit, a spinner, a button.

pairs.dont: Put a border on the input inside the group.
pairs.do: Let the group draw the box and keep the input bare.
pairs.why: Only then does the focus ring surround the addons too. Draw it on the input and the ring stops at the icon.

pairs.dont: Write the unit into the placeholder — 'Threshold in ms'.
pairs.do: Put it in a trailing text addon, so it stays visible once there is a value.
pairs.why: A placeholder disappears exactly when the person needs to check what they typed.

pairs.do: Leave icons out of the tab order; give real controls a label.
pairs.why: Every stop in the tab order costs a keyboard user a keystroke. A search icon is not worth one.

pairs.dont: Pass invalid or disabled to the group as a prop.
pairs.do: Set aria-invalid or disabled on the input; the group reads it.
pairs.why: One source of truth. The thing that is invalid is the value, and the value lives in the input.

pairs.dont: Stack a unit, a spinner and two buttons into one trailing slot.
pairs.do: Keep one thing per side, and move the rest out of the field.
pairs.why: The field shrinks to fit whatever you put beside it, and a 60px input is not a field any more.

a11y: The group is role="group" and the control inside it is bare. The group reads the inner control's aria-invalid and :disabled through :has(), so the border, the ring and the disabled tokens all follow the real control rather than a prop someone can forget.
This is where invalid lives for Input, Select, Textarea, Number and Password: has-[[aria-invalid=true]]:border-line-input-invalid on the group. The controls themselves add nothing.
Clicking the group focuses the control — but only when the click did not land on a button, link or another field, and only when the control is not disabled.
The spinner is role="status" with an sr-only label, so a busy field announces itself. The check mark has one too.
InputGroupInfo is an icon-only button; its label becomes the aria-label and the Info glyph is aria-hidden.
